+"""Safe loading of images referenced by user-settable paths/URLs.
+
+The backend never makes an outbound HTTP request for such a reference
+(SSRF). Only these are served:
+  * ``data:image`` URLs (decoded locally)
+  * relative storage paths (read through the storage service)
+  * absolute URLs under our own STORAGE_HOST (mapped to a storage path and
+    read through the storage service, not fetched over HTTP)
+Everything else is refused (returns None).
+"""
+import base64
+import posixpath
+from typing import Optional
+from urllib.parse import unquote, urlsplit
+
+from app.core.config import settings
+
+
+def _storage_relative_path(url: str) -> Optional[str]:
+    """Map an absolute URL under STORAGE_HOST to a storage-relative path."""
+    host = urlsplit(settings.STORAGE_HOST or "")
+    parts = urlsplit(url)
+    if not host.hostname or parts.scheme not in ("http", "https"):
+        return None
+    if parts.scheme != host.scheme or parts.netloc.lower() != host.netloc.lower():
+        return None
+    if parts.query or parts.fragment or parts.username or parts.password:
+        return None
+    prefix = host.path.rstrip("/") + "/"
+    if not parts.path.startswith(prefix):
+        return None
+    return _clean_relative(unquote(parts.path[len(prefix):]))
+
+
+def _clean_relative(path: str) -> Optional[str]:
+    if not path or "\\" in path or "\x00" in path or path.startswith("/"):
+        return None
+    if any(seg in ("..", ".") for seg in path.split("/")):
+        return None
+    return posixpath.normpath(path)
+
+
+def load_image_bytes(ref: Optional[str]) -> Optional[bytes]:
+    """Return image bytes for a data: URL, storage path or own-storage URL."""
+    if not ref:
+        return None
+    ref = ref.strip()
+    try:
+        if ref.lower().startswith("data:"):
+            if not ref.lower().startswith("data:image"):
+                return None
+            _, encoded = ref.split(",", 1)
+            return base64.b64decode(encoded)
+
+        # Any other scheme or scheme-relative form ("//host/x") is not ours.
+        if ref.startswith("//") or "://" in ref or ":" in ref.split("/", 1)[0]:
+            rel = _storage_relative_path(ref)
+        else:
+            rel = _clean_relative(ref)
+        if rel is None:
+            return None
+
+        from app.services.storage import storage
+        return storage.download_image(rel)
+    except Exception:
+        return None

+import base64
+import io
+
+import pytest
+import requests
+from PIL import Image
+
+from tests.conftest import signup
+
+
+def _png() -> bytes:
+    buf = io.BytesIO()
+    Image.new("RGB", (4, 4), (255, 0, 0)).save(buf, format="PNG")
+    return buf.getvalue()
+
+
+@pytest.fixture()
+def no_network(monkeypatch):
+    calls = []
+
+    def boom(*a, **k):
+        calls.append(a)
+        raise AssertionError("outbound request attempted")
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(requests, "get", boom)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(requests.Session, "request", boom)
+    return calls
+
+
+def _episode_with_cut(client, h, image_path):
+    p = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=h, json={"title": "P", "genres": []}).json()
+    e = client.post("/api/v1/episodes", headers=h, json={"title": "E", "project_id": p["id"], "episode_order": 1})
+    assert e.status_code == 200, e.text
+    eid = e.json()["id"]
+    c = client.post("/api/v1/cuts", headers=h, json={"episode_id": eid, "cut_order": 1, "script": ""})
+    assert c.status_code == 200, c.text
+    r = client.put(f"/api/v1/cuts/{c.json()['id']}", headers=h, json={"image_path": image_path})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return eid
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("url", [
+    "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/",
+    "http://localhost:8000/api/v1/projects",
+    "http://10.0.0.5/secret.png",
+    "https://example.com/x.png",
+    "//internal.host/x.png",
+    "http://minio.invalid:9000.evil.com/toonify-prod-assets/a.png",
+    "http://minio.invalid:9000/other-bucket/a.png",
+    "http://minio.invalid:9000/toonify-prod-assets/../../x.png",
+    "http://user@minio.invalid:9000/toonify-prod-assets/a.png@evil/x",
+    "file:///etc/passwd",
+])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("fmt", ["zip", "webtoon"])
+def test_export_never_requests_user_urls(client, no_network, url, fmt):
+    h = signup(client)
+    eid = _episode_with_cut(client, h, url)
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{eid}/export?format={fmt}", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 400
+    assert no_network == []
+
+
+def test_export_zip_serves_storage_and_data_urls(client, no_network):
+    from app.core.config import settings
+    from app.services.storage import storage
+
+    h = signup(client)
+    rel = storage.upload_image(_png(), "cuts", "x")
+    for ref in (rel, f"{settings.STORAGE_HOST}/{rel}",
+                "data:image/png;base64," + base64.b64encode(_png()).decode()):
+        eid = _episode_with_cut(client, h, ref)
+        r = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{eid}/export?format=zip", headers=h)
+        assert r.status_code == 200, (ref, r.text)
+        assert r.headers["content-type"] == "application/zip"
+    assert no_network == []
+
+
+def test_ai_and_reference_board_downloads_refuse_internal_urls(no_network):
+    from app.services import reference_board
+    from app.services.ai.base import BaseAIService
+
+    url = "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/"
+    assert reference_board.download_image(url) is None
+    svc = BaseAIService.__new__(BaseAIService)
+    assert svc._download_image(url) is None

+
+
+def test_ai_and_reference_board_still_load_storage_images(no_network):
+    from app.core.config import settings
+    from app.services import reference_board
+    from app.services.ai.base import BaseAIService
+    from app.services.storage import storage
+
+    rel = storage.upload_image(_png(), "chars", "y")
+    svc = BaseAIService.__new__(BaseAIService)
+    for ref in (rel, f"{settings.STORAGE_HOST}/{rel}"):
+        assert svc._download_image(ref) == _png()
+        assert reference_board.download_image(ref) is not None
+
+
+def _add_cut(client, h, eid, order, image_path):
+    c = client.post("/api/v1/cuts", headers=h, json={"episode_id": eid, "cut_order": order, "script": ""})
+    assert c.status_code == 200, c.text
+    if image_path is not None:
+        r = client.put(f"/api/v1/cuts/{c.json()['id']}", headers=h, json={"image_path": image_path})
+        assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+
+
+def _mixed_episode(client, h):
+    """Cut 1 ok, 2 no image, 3 refused URL, 4 ok, 5 missing from storage."""
+    from app.services.storage import storage
+
+    ok = storage.upload_image(_png(), "cuts", "m")
+    eid = _episode_with_cut(client, h, ok)  # cut 1
+    _add_cut(client, h, eid, 2, None)
+    _add_cut(client, h, eid, 3, "http://10.0.0.5/x.png")
+    _add_cut(client, h, eid, 4, ok)
+    _add_cut(client, h, eid, 5, "cuts/m/not-there.png")
+    return eid
+
+
+def test_zip_lists_missing_cuts(client, no_network):

+
+    h = signup(client)

+

+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("fmt", ["zip", "webtoon"])
+def test_nothing_missing_means_no_file_and_no_header(client, no_network, fmt):

+    h = signup(client)
